inputs: Only frozen teacher_prepare completion, teacher_rows and prefix_fit. No quality predictions, evaluation statistics, manual target GT or new teacher requests.
predefined_outputs: all six setting final-prefix counts, not a sum of overlapping prefixes
within-group excitation Gram and excited group fraction
Huber tail rows/weight and local optimization curvature, not Fisher information
conditional quadratic-reference beta and whether its full-quadratic assumptions hold
